keyPoints.en: Carbohydrates (energy), proteins (growth, repair), fats (stored energy), vitamins and minerals (body functions), fibre (digestion), water.
keyPoints.bm: Karbohidrat (tenaga), protein (pertumbuhan, pembaikan), lemak (simpanan tenaga), vitamin dan mineral (fungsi badan), serat (penghadaman), air.

keyPoints.en: Deficiencies: vitamin C → scurvy, iron → anaemia, vitamin D/calcium → rickets, iodine → goitre.
keyPoints.bm: Kekurangan: vitamin C → skurvi, zat besi → anemia, vitamin D/kalsium → riket, iodin → goiter.

keyPoints.en: Pinggan Sihat Malaysia: ½ vegetables and fruit, ¼ grains, ¼ protein, with plain water.
keyPoints.bm: Pinggan Sihat Malaysia: ½ sayur dan buah, ¼ bijirin, ¼ protein, bersama air kosong.

tip.en: Picture your plate in four parts before you eat.
tip.bm: Bayangkan pinggan dalam empat bahagian sebelum makan.

keyPoints.en: Read labels: compare sugar, salt and fat per 100 g; check expiry dates.
keyPoints.bm: Baca label: bandingkan gula, garam dan lemak setiap 100 g; semak tarikh luput.

keyPoints.en: Eat breakfast, choose steamed or grilled food, drink plain water, limit sugary drinks.
keyPoints.bm: Bersarapan, pilih makanan kukus atau panggang, minum air kosong, kurangkan minuman bergula.
